source.note: common.md Frontmatter: an indented closing delimiter under an unindented opening one cannot be reconciled by removing leading whitespace, so the `---` pseudo-diagram rejects the text.

error.name: Error
error.message: Diagrams beginning with --- are not valid. If you were trying to use a YAML front-matter, please ensure that you've correctly opened and closed the YAML front-matter with un-indented `---` blocks
